AI automation for small business

Let repetitive work run by itself: emails, quotes, planning, social media and customer questions. With AI tools that connect the apps you already use, at a fixed price.

Compared with the market

An AI agent built with no-code tools such as Zapier or Make costs a one-off €2,000 to €8,000 in the Netherlands (Searchlab, 2026). With us, a single automation starts at €395. All prices are final prices in euros: no VAT is added.

Which package fits you?

  • Automation (from €395): you keep handling the same form, email or overview and want it to happen by itself.
  • AI chatbot (from €995): customers keep asking the same questions about opening hours, prices or delivery times. Read more about the AI chatbot.
  • AI assistant (from €1,950): several workflows across email, calendar, documents and CRM, with you in control.

Not sure? Describe what you do again every week, and we will tell you honestly which package fits, or that you can solve it without us.

How it works

  1. Tell us by email which work keeps coming back.
  2. You get a free concept and a fixed price.
  3. After you approve, we build it and test it with you.
  4. Then it goes live.

Frequently asked questions

Do you need my passwords?

No. We use official integrations and you stay in control of your accounts. Where a tool needs access, you grant it yourself through that tool's own permission screen, and you can revoke it at any time. We only set up the access an automation actually needs, nothing more.

Which tools do you work with?

Tools such as Make and Zapier and the apps you already use, like your email, calendar, spreadsheets and CRM. We prefer to build on what you already have, so you do not need new subscriptions unless they really add something. Before the quote we check your setup and tell you whether any tool costs extra.

What if something breaks?

Every automation is tested with real examples and documented, so you know what it does and where. If an app you use changes, a connection can occasionally stop working. With management (€49 a month) we monitor your automations, get notified when something fails and fix small issues. Without management, we fix it as a separate job at our hourly rate.

Do you work with businesses outside the Netherlands?

Yes. We work fully online, by email and video, with clients worldwide, in English or Dutch. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere, with no VAT added. Time zones are rarely a problem: most of the work is done in writing, and calls are planned at a time that suits you.
